title: 市场以为还有更多：克拉里达却说三次就收尾，12月加息后还有一次？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Where we're going to be April 28th next year, June 9th next year, July 28th, when nominal GDP finally comes in from this crazy level, it's a whole new dialogue.
segments.zh: 明年4月28日、6月9日、7月28日，当名义GDP最终从当前高位回落时，将开启全新对话。

segments.en: What kind of assumptions underpin that view that the GDP is going to roll over? What's if you want CapEx, what are the tech players doing, how much money they're going to make some calls right now on AI and tech?
segments.zh: GDP将下滑的观点基于哪些假设？资本开支方面，科技公司有何动作？他们在AI和科技领域投入多少资金？

segments.en: Stephanie says on this, it's brilliant. I mean, okay, next year it finally comes in. We're completely unprepared for that.
segments.zh: Stephanie对此表示赞赏。我的意思是，明年数据最终出炉时，我们完全没准备好。

segments.en: Williams says one attempt, by the way. Williams has been pretty outspoken on that. He thinks one and done is his best guess. Can you share your best guess with us this afternoon? Is it one and done?
segments.zh: 顺便说，Williams对此直言不讳。他认为一次加息后就会结束。您能分享您的最佳猜测吗？是一次就结束吗？

segments.en: Well, our view has been they will go in December and depending on the day to flow, they can go again in March. That scenario is essentially they're hiking a total of three times and then they're done.
segments.zh: 我们的观点是，他们将在12月加息，并根据数据流，可能在3月再次加息。该情景本质上是总共加息三次，然后结束。

segments.en: And that takes back the cuts in 2025, which at the time we're sort of viewed as risk management cuts because the labor market looked like it was tanking.
segments.zh: 这撤销了2025年的降息，当时这些降息被视为风险管理式降息，因为劳动力市场看似在走弱。

segments.en: We basically had flat or negative prints in the labor market data. You don't have those risk management concerns and my sense is that you have a committee that has a comfort level with that right now thinking that will be the destination.
segments.zh: 劳动力市场数据基本持平或为负。没有这些风险管理担忧，我认为委员会目前对此感到安心，并认为那将是终点。
